evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected complete unwind groups, instruction roles and direct call edges. Floating frame-gain ABI uses RCX, XMM1, XMM2 and R9b, not four integer registers.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Effect consumption can materialize descriptor-owner previous/target gains into PCM and reset both words to unity before virtual effect execution. The selected scalar-buffer branch passes an existing descriptor to the effect object; separate-output and multi-object branches can replace the selected collection. EQ output gain can also remain pending in identified descriptor-owner words when LFE inclusion permits a uniform operation. LFE exclusion takes an inline channel path; output gain state is updated after either branch.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Selected current object/collection layouts, task/control/mode branches, readable retained fields and valid processor dispatch are required. The checked static service object/table identifies a current interface implementation; live EQ cache selection remains conditional. Current expression programs are rederived from current instructions and do not promote historical numeric/PCM cohorts. Current isolated SSE/AVX original-kernel comparisons support the checked first-output operand cases, including the current AVX rounding difference; they do not establish live service/cache selection.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Live whole-effect arithmetic outside the admitted EQ first-buffer block, full history transitions and output-gain ramps; whole buffers/channels, general Compressor detector controls/state, other task branches, concurrent unobserved writers, allocation generations, complete Event contribution and audibility.

taskSampling.unselectedRoots: Unobserved tasks cannot establish global bus coverage or generation absence.

evidenceBoundary.direct: Observed first effect object vtable target and nested frame-gain caller identify this selected collection kernel. The driver gain prepass is suppressed on the representative master branch, while the kernel applies pending owner gains itself.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Valid identified owners and native control/LFE branches select deferred descriptor gain or inline PCM processing. Current direct calls, fields and factory/table identity are static evidence; historical controlled-body cases were not rerun.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Live parameter/state values, every detector/compression mode and every channel layout. Registration/factory/vtable identity is separate from those DSP claims.

biquadProcessing.evidenceBoundary: First buffer PCM before/after, five coefficients, four history words, processor selector, frame/segment/buffer counts and entry MXCSR. These are local DSP operands, not every channel or full Event contribution.

sse.boundary: Current first-output expression DAG independently derived from the complete current two-buffer instruction path. First-buffer dependencies exclude the other buffer and later input. Valid uniform full frames, selected processor branch, nearest rounding and supported finite normal intermediates are required. Historical controlled-kernel comparisons are not current execution proof. Current isolated original-kernel/private-buffer comparisons also agree for the explicitly bounded checked operand cases.

avx.boundary: Current first-output expression DAG independently derived from the complete current two-buffer instruction path. First-buffer dependencies exclude the other buffer and later input. Valid uniform full frames, selected processor branch, nearest rounding and supported finite normal intermediates are required. Historical controlled-kernel comparisons are not current execution proof. Current isolated original-kernel/private-buffer comparisons agree for the checked operand cases; an existing nontrivial vector distinguishes current AVX rounding from the historical expression.

serviceIdentity.scope: Static service object/table and current EQ global read; live cache identity and plugin-context selection are sampled conditions.
